newsitem.title: UK: Clarke urges UK Conservatives to unite over EMU.
newsitem.headline: Clarke urges UK Conservatives to unite over EMU.

text.p: Chancellor of the Exchequer Kenneth Clarke said on Thursday the Conservative Party must unite behind the government's policy on a single currency.
Britain must keep its options open on a single currency and influence the discussions taking place within Europe, he said.
"It is in Britain's interest to keep all our options open," Clarke said in a keynote speech prepared for delivery at the ruling Conservative Party's annual conference in Bournemouth.
"We should decide when we have to, not before. So let us spend the next six months uniting behind that policy," Clarke said.
"By staying in the game we sacrifice nothing, and we gain much," Clarke said. "At every stage, we will have the right to say no."
